result.title: DeliMF: Gated Cross-Attention Fusion of Structured Time Series and Clinical Text for Early Intensive Care Delirium Prediction
result.summary: Delirium affects a large fraction of intensive care unit (ICU) patients and foreshadows longer stays, lasting cognitive decline, and higher mortality. Flagging the patients who will become delirious within the first day of admission would give clinicians a window to intervene. Yet state-of-the-art predictors rely only on the structured electronic health record (EHR) of vital signs, laboratory values, and medications, while overlooking the free-text clinical notes written in the same window, which carry information the numbers cannot encode. To this end, we present DeliMF, a multimodal framework that fuses the structured time series with clinical text. It encodes the structured signals with a temporal Transformer and the time-stamped radiology reports with a clinical text encoder, and fuses the two through a gated cross-attention module. The gate learns a per-patient weight on the text; when a patient has no note the gate closes and DeliMF reduces to its structured-only form, giving robustness to missing text by construction. On an incident-only MIMIC-IV cohort, DeliMF improves significantly over the baselines, particularly on patients who carry clinical text, while losing nothing on those without. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of multimodal fusion and gated cross-attention, and a case study further shows that fusing clinical text with the structured stream recovers delirium cases that the structured data alone misses. We hope DeliMF encourages early ICU prediction to make fuller use of the overlooked clinical text and contributes to the early identification and timely intervention of delirium.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出 DeliMF，用时间 Transformer 编码 ICU 结构化生命体征等时序、用临床文本编码器编码带时间戳的报告，并通过 gated cross-attention 融合，做入院首日谵妄预测，在 MIMIC-IV 队列上优于纯结构化基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按样本学习的门控可让文本缺失时退化为单模态结构分支，这一「模态贡献门控/旁路」设计可为 LVR 中视觉证据是否被真正使用、视觉旁路的检测与抑制提供可核查的架构线索，但任务本身属临床预测应用，与 latent 推理状态无直接关系。
